ap_groups.all_participants: Everyone taking that language's AP exam, including the standard-group subset.
ap_groups.korean: College Board lists AP Chinese and AP Japanese, but no AP Korean exam. Korean benchmarks use MLA college enrollments separately.
ap_groups.relationship: The standard group is already included in all participants. Never add them together.
ap_groups.standard_group: A subset whose answers did not report regularly speaking or hearing the exam language, or living for at least one month where it is spoken. Generally school-trained, but not a U.S.-only or ancestry group.
ap_groups.years: Years are annual exam administrations, not graduating classes. Verified counts run from 2007 through 2025. The 2026 score-percentage rows do not provide participant counts.

uk_chinese_studies.note: Subject-apportioned enrollments, not admissions or all Mandarin learners. Historical source data are kept in complete downloads; they do not qualify as a current public plot. No U.S./UK learner total is calculated.
